Your vault runs a release that is not in this app\'s list of vault releases, so VettID did not ask for your PIN and sent nothing. The app loads the list again each time you try. Try again; if this keeps happening, update VettID.

Your vault\'s software could not be verified. Nothing was sent to it: not your PIN, nor anything else. Try again; if this keeps happening, do not enter your PIN anywhere else and contact VettID support.
This vault\'s software is not for this app. Contact VettID.
Nothing was found.

This phone no longer holds the keys of your vault. That happens when the app\'s data was cleared or the phone was set up again from a backup. Nothing was disclosed. Whether you can get back into the vault depends on one of its settings. If its credential backup was on (the usual case), you can recover it: start a recovery on the account site. It takes one to three days, and you need your PIN and your password. If you had turned credential backup off, this vault cannot be brought back; you can delete it on the account site and start a new one. If you still have a phone on which VettID works, use \'Move to a new phone\' there instead. The account site tells you which of these applies.

VettID\'s account service says that your account has no vault. That is what it says after a vault was deleted or an account closed, and it can also be a fault of the service. If you did not delete your vault, do not start over: try again later.

VettID could not remove your vault\'s keys from this phone. Try again. If it keeps failing, erase VettID\'s data on this phone. Your vault itself is not affected: afterwards you can set VettID up again or recover your vault from your account.

VettID could not read the keys it keeps on this phone for your vault. Nothing was deleted or changed. Try again, or restart the phone and open VettID again. If it stays like this, this phone cannot open your vault any more, and the way back is to erase VettID here and recover your vault.
VettID is still checking whether your last change went through. Try again when your vault can be reached.
VettID is still checking whether your last PIN change went through. This can take up to about 10 minutes. Try again then.
VettID is still checking whether your last password change went through. This can take up to about 10 minutes. Try again then.
VettID is still finishing an earlier request to your vault. Nothing was changed. Try again in a minute.

VettID couldn\'t confirm whether your PIN was changed, because something else changed in your vault at the same time. To find out without using an attempt, lock your vault and unlock it again: VettID will ask for each PIN in turn.
VettID couldn\'t confirm your last new phone secret. Before you change your PIN, lock your vault and unlock it again: your PIN hasn\'t changed, so this doesn\'t use an attempt.
Something went wrong. Try again.
This phone can\'t use your vault

Your vault does not count this phone as the one that holds its credential, so it refused the request. Nothing was disclosed, and your PIN and password were not checked. This usually means a recovery of your vault was started and has not finished. If you recovered your vault on another phone, open VettID on that phone and unlock it to finish. Otherwise, start a recovery on the account site: it takes one to three days, and you need your PIN and your password. If another phone of yours now opens your vault, use \'Move to a new phone\' there instead.
